parties: IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited (acquirer; material subsidiary of Amber Enterprises); Ascent Circuits Private Limited (target; step-down subsidiary of Amber)
headline: IL JIN to raise stake in Ascent Circuits from 60% to 98.50% via additional 38.50% acquisition
sum: IL JIN Electronics, a material subsidiary of Amber Enterprises, executed share purchase agreements on 18 June 2026 to acquire an additional 38.50% equity stake in Ascent Circuits Private Limited, a subsidiary of IL JIN and step-down subsidiary of Amber, raising IL JIN's holding from 60% to 98.50% in one or more tranches.
detail: Amber Enterprises' subsidiary IL JIN Electronics (India) Private Limited executed SPAs for acquisition of an additional 38.50% equity stake in Ascent Circuits Private Limited on 18 June 2026. The transaction will increase IL JIN's shareholding from 60% to 98.50% and will be completed in one or more tranches. The transaction is a group-level consolidation within Amber's subsidiary structure. No transaction value was disclosed in the exchange filing. The acquisition involves a step-down subsidiary (Ascent held by IL JIN, which is held by Amber).
